app.name: Nintendont (Multiworld)
app.long_description:
Commiters: GerbilSoft, JoostinOnline, GreyRogue, Howard, Cyan, Pwootage, Henrique Gemignani, Miepee
Project website: https://github.com/randovania/Nintendont
Nintendont allows you to run GameCube games on a Wii or Wii U from an SD or HDD device. This version has modifications which allow you to manipulate game memory over the network.
